page_title: DAR 0-1 FRE | Darmstadt v Freiburg 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' What a big chance! Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
90+4' Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Noah Atubolu and he's equal to it.
90+3' A cross into the box from Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt) is cleared.
90+2' Christian Streich has decided to substitute Ritsu Doan and he is replaced by Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg).
90+1' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Maximilian Breunig (Freiburg) is brought on as a substitute for Michael Gregoritsch.
88' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
86' That was close. Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
85' Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
83' Florent Muslija (Freiburg) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
81' Here is a change. Fabian Holland is going off and Torsten Lieberknecht gives the last tactical orders to Fabian Schnellhardt (Darmstadt).
81' Emir Karic goes off the pitch and Fabio Torsiello (Darmstadt) comes on.
78' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post.
77' Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
77' Darmstadt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
76' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Darmstadt.
75' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Matej Maglica (Darmstadt).
75' The free kick from long range, taken by Darmstadt, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
74' Foul! Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Darmstadt are awarded a free kick.

73' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for an infringement. Darmstadt will take a free kick near the side line.
73' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) replacing Matthias Bader.
72' Christian Streich decides to make a substitution. Roland Sallai will be replaced by Florent Muslija (Freiburg).
72' It's time for a substitution. Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) comes on in place of Christian Gunter.
70' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
69' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Freiburg get a corner.
68' Here's the change. Oscar Vilhelmsson leaves the pitch and Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) comes on as a substitute.
68' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to make a change. Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) replaces Tobias Kempe.
66' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marcel Schuhen, who smothers the ball.
62' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt).
60' Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
59' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
56' Great chance! Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar.
54' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
53' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) sends a long ball in, but Marcel Schuhen comfortably gathers the ball.
51' The shot by Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Noah Atubolu.
50' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
46' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
46' The game is over for Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg). Merlin Rohl comes on for the second half.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt), but the defence gets it clear.
45+2' Darmstadt couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
44' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Roland Sallai (Freiburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

42' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
41' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
40' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

38' A pass travels right across the box to Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Marcel Schuhen denies him with a decent save.
36' 0 - 1 Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) accepts a sweet pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the helpless goalkeeper.
35' A player from Darmstadt brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Freiburg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
33' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
32' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
31' It's a throw-in for Darmstadt.
28' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
27' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
23' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
21' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
17' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) picks up a long through ball, but Marcel Schuhen deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
14' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
13' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
12' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
10' The ball is cleared after Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
8' Marcel Schuhen is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Lukas Kubler (Freiburg). Easy save!
7' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
4' This is a yellow card! Roland Sallai (Freiburg) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
3' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the left post.

1' Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
1' The first half has just begun.
Darmstadt will kick the game off.
Sascha Stegemann will supervise the game today.
